accountId.description: The ID of your Ably account.

status.description: The status of the application. Can be `enabled` or `disabled`. Enabled means available to accept inbound connections and all services are available.

tlsOnly.description: Enforce TLS for all connections. This setting overrides any channel setting.

apnsUseSandboxEndpoint.description: Use the Apple Push Notification service sandbox endpoint.

_links.description: A link self-referencing the app that has been created.
